shorts_extract.hook: When your right hand buttons your shirt and your left hand unbuttons it: how Alien Hand Syndrome exposed the brain's hidden 'free won't' brake.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Goldberg et al. (1981) medial frontal SMA lesion cases + Feinberg et al. (1992) Frontal-Grasp vs Callosal-Conflict anatomical split.
shorts_extract.twist: Ownership ('my hand') vs Agency ('my choice'), why your brain preps silent grabs at every mug you pass, and the foam-ball rehabilitation trick.
